snapshot.scope_description: Default deployment of the OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop: core, full (Kafka), observability and agent compose layers.
omissions: Android/React Native app, profiling and extras compose layers, and test containers are not modeled.
Per-service interfaces and the observability concern are omitted to keep the view readable.
Only the orders topic is modeled; the collector's Kafka metrics scrape is a plain request to the broker.
